justification: Both are vertical stone works with rounded tops bearing shallow relief that includes schematic human forms, headgear and circular disc elements, which is the most specific shared vocabulary. But A is a massive, three-dimensional anthropomorphic monolith in dark coarse stone whose ornament wraps a body-shaped block, while B is a flat, thin pale plaque with a scene of small side-by-side figures in fine incised relief, so the format, scale, material and compositional logic differ fundamentally.
